title: Manager and Salesman
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Michael attempts to confirm a hotel reservation for the Olympics, while Jo Bennett visits the office, leading to interactions with staff. Jim offers to step down as manager, resulting in Michael learning he will be the sole manager again. The episode also features Dwight and Ryan planning a diabolical plot against Jim, and various humorous misunderstandings and interactions among the staff.
